facts.text: The US Army has solicited ruggedized sensor technology to enable forward and reverse collision warning plus automatic brake assist on military vehicles, demonstrating active interest rather than a documented validation case.
facts.quote: The US Army has solicited ruggedized sensor technology to enable forward and reverse collision warning plus automatic brake assist on military vehicles, which shows active interest

facts.text: A publicly documented operational military ground-vehicle AEB safety case with quantified simulation substitution was not found; the cited US Army evidence is a government requirement statement, not a validation case.
